name: StartupLibrary

sources.title: Submit page — pay-what-you-want launch from $1 one-time; $15+ skips the queue and picks launch date; every approved launch earns a permanent DR 33 dofollow backlink

requirements: Minimum $1 one-time payment ('choose your own price'); every $1 = 1 leaderboard point
Under $15 joins the queue; $15+ lets you pick your launch date before checkout
Submissions are approved launches — there is an approval step
preparation: Product name, URL, tagline/description and imagery for the product page
Budget decision: $1 minimum queues you; $15+ schedules the launch; ~299 points (~$299) to open at top of trending
workflow: Click 'Start my submission' and fill the product details
Pay once — listing is 'forever' with a permanent dofollow backlink
Earn additional points from views/product-page visits; top 5 weekly get newsletter feature
watchFor: No true free tier — minimum spend is $1
Leaderboard is pay-per-point plus engagement; top of trending was ~299 points
Dofollow claim is self-reported (DR 33) — verify the link after launch
Site carries 'featured on' badge spam typical of new launch boards
countsAsLive: A product page resolves on startuplibrary.net with a working outbound link and the startup appears on the leaderboard/discover pages
